items.article: United Airlines passengers will have a cheaper option for luxury seating. See more of our coverage in your search results. United Airlines has officially launched a cheaper first-class fare — and it’s pretty basic. The airline giant will offer passengers first-class status with its new “base” fare. Starting in the fall, the Chicago-based company will roll out three fare options for United First and United Business. The new choices — base, standard and flexible. Its newest fare — base — is now the lowest tier in the first-class cabin , coming with more restrictions, like fees for seat selections and fewer checked baggage items. “You can select the tier with benefits that fit your travel needs. No matter which tier you select, your fare will include the same elevated onboard experience offered in that cabin,” the United website reads. Base does not include changes to flights or refunds — passengers must book the flexible tier to secure those amenities.

items.key: ai:look inside: luxury kinsale penthouse with sea views for €3.25m
items.text: Look inside: Luxury Kinsale penthouse with sea views for €3.25m
items.article: Airy and spacious three-bed built on the site of a former Mercy Convent in popular west Cork location Imagine waking up in a penthouse and walking to the balcony outside your bedroom. Below you is the sea and in the distance, bobbing sail boats. A new luxury penthouse, built on the site of a former Mercy Convent in Kinsale , Co Cork , could afford you this experience. One of four apartments called Schooner Cove, the last of 30 to be built in a complex called Avila, the penthouse takes up the entire top floor of the former convent and offers incredible views. Developed by Cumnor Construction, the project is a far cry from the former Convent of Mercy and school, which formerly occupied the site. It opened in 1845 with 700 pupils and six Mercy Sisters at the start of the Irish famine. The convent and industrial school closed decades ago, and the school, convent, chapel and gardens were later sold. The three-bedroom penthouse, which spans 297sq m (3,200sq ft), was designed by JCA Architects. Airy and spacious, with high ceilings and elegant original columns, its rooms are differentiated by smoked-glass panel doors. Its large open-plan kitchen/dining/sittingroom opens to a terrace with sea views. The furnishings rely mostly on muted tones of grey, taupe, beige and blue, which combine well with its minimalist design and futuristic-style light fittings. One of the most striking aspects of this apartment is the large original sash ecclesiastical windows in the sittingroom space.

items.article: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park’s iconic 90-foot Hōlei Sea Arch has collapsed into the Pacific Ocean following Tropical Storm Nolo. See more of our coverage in your search results. Hawaii’s iconic Hōlei Sea Arch has collapsed into the Pacific Ocean, disappearing just days after visitors were still photographing the landmark. The 90-foot arch at Hawaii Volcanoes National Park on the Big Island was standing firm Wednesday, Sept. 23, but was gone by Sunday night, according to the National Park Service . Officials do not know exactly when the tourist attraction fell and suspect it may have happened while the park was temporarily closed for three days during Tropical Storm Nolo . Nolo brought heavy rain and powerful winds to the Big Island last week, triggering flash flooding and road closures. Visitors were warned to stay away from the site near Hōlei Sea Arch, where the cliffs drop straight into the Pacific and can collapse without warning.

items.article: Management consultant Aayush Joshi shared his transformation after losing 30 kg, noting that the most noticeable change for others was the reduction in face fat and more defined facial features. Consultant dermatologist Dr Shweta Nakhawa explained that as overall body fat decreases, facial fat can also reduce, making the cheekbones and jawline more prominent, although the extent varies based on genetics, age, fat distribution and the pace of weight loss. She clarified that face fat cannot be selectively targeted through diet or exercise and cautioned against rapid weight loss, which may lead to facial hollowness or skin laxity. For healthier-looking skin after major weight loss, she recommended gradual weight reduction, adequate protein and balanced nutrition, hydration, sufficient sleep and regular sun protection. Management consultant Aayush Joshi took to Instagram to share before-and-after photos of his drastic face-fat loss after losing 30 kg. “Face fat was probably the most talked-about change after I lost 30 kg. Of course, the transformation happened across my whole body, but people noticed my face first. The features became more defined, and honestly, that’s what I heard the most about. But the visible changes are only half the story. There are changes you can’t really see… more confidence, better mental health, and a deeper sense of self-love. items.text: There are 14 astronauts in space today as new crew arrives. Where are they from?
items.article: With 14 humans floating around in orbit, the question is whether the human population in space has reached a new record. Fourteen humans are currently living and working in space, all of them aboard the two permanently occupied space stations in low Earth orbit; the International Space Station (ISS) and China's Tiangong Space Station. The number reached 14 after Nasa 's SpaceX Crew-13 docked with the ISS in the early monring hours of October 2 (in IST), temporarily taking the station's population to 11. Meanwhile, Tiangong has three astronauts aboard as part of China's Shenzhou-23 mission. Watch SpaceX Crew-13 make its historic journey to the International Space Station pic.twitter.com/5f88VA0Zh6 — sen (@sen) October 2, 2026 ISS HOSTS 11 ASTRONAUTS The ISS is currently in the middle of a crew handover under Expedition 75. The seven astronauts and cosmonauts who were already aboard have been joined by Crew-13's four members. The new arrivals are Nasa astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov.
